incomplete_store_trace: store_review accepts recognised incomplete/unparsed statuses and writes partial reviews (review.py:3481-3567).
_write_record writes via review_records.record_written and unconditionally invokes note_review_record (review.py:4333-4340).
record_stage deduplicates stage/attempt/outcome and preserves the first instant (stage_receipts.py:132-136).
A later parsed write with the same reviewing run therefore cannot replace the premature completion instant. This is a code reading, not an executed mutation.
